sources: Titan Extractor blueprints can be purchased in the Market for 50,000 Credits. Blueprints are reusable.
It was first available to the Blaze and Inferno levels of Ember Prime Access.

This extractor returned temporarily at December 8, 2015 through January 5, 2016 as part of the purchase-able Prime Vault, along with Frost Prime, Latron Prime, and Reaper Prime, as well as Misa Prime Syandana, and Frost Prime avatars.
It can only be obtained by buying the Prime Vault pack, however.

It was also available as a part of the Vanguard Prime Resurgence Part 1 until January 15, 2026, at 2 p.m. ET for 1 Regal Aya, or as part of the Ember Prime Pack, the Frost Prime Pack, and the Ember & Frost Prime Dual Pack.
Distilling Extractor blueprints can be purchased in the Market for 50,000 Credits. Blueprints are reusable.

Originally, it was only available to the Stomp level of Rhino Prime Access and its associated Prime Accessories pack but has been included in the Brains and Brawn Prime Vault pack, the Brute Prime pack, the Rhino Prime Accessories pack, the Magnetic Mayhem Prime Vault pack, Mag Prime pack, and the Mag Prime Accessories pack.
The Distilling Extractor Prime came back for a limited time for Prime Resurgence with either 1 Regal Aya from Varzia, the Mag Prime Pack, or the Mag and Nova Prime Dual Pack.
